rules.statement: The Court has a discretion to refuse discovery of documents where it can see that no good is reasonably to be expected from ordering it, and whether any good is to be expected can be ascertained by looking at the pleadings.
rules.supporting_quote: "It would appear that the order made on February 5,1920, regarding the filing of an affidavit was made in error, because the motion has endorsement by plaintiff's proctor of receipt of notice for 11th instant (i.e., for to-day). I would, therefore, vacate the order of February 5, 1920, and I would refuse to order affidavit as applied for. Costs of this inquiry to be borne by applicant (defendant)."
